title: The Equidistant Dimension of Corona Product Graphs
summary: A subset $S$ of vertices, in a connected graph $G$, is called a distance-equalizer set if for every pair of distinct vertices outside $S$, there exists a vertex in $S$ equidistant to both. The equidistant dimension, denoted by $ξ(G)$, is defined as the minimum cardinality of such sets. While several distance-based parameters have been studied for different graph products, the equidistant dimension of corona product graphs has remained unexplored.
